subject.title: fix(gateway): enforce plugin-ownership check in sessions.patch

question: Should this branch become the canonical fix with plugin-runtime callers failing closed on every legacy ownerless session row after upgrade?
rationale: Code evidence favors this race-safe implementation, but exact authority over rows created before ownership metadata existed—and the resulting upgrade disruption—requires explicit maintainer security and compatibility intent.

options.title: Adopt fail-closed enforcement
options.body: Use this branch, require exact owner equality immediately, document supported recovery for legacy rows, and obtain deployed proof before merge.

options.title: Add doctor migration first
options.body: Keep this implementation shape but migrate or quarantine legacy ownerless rows before enabling runtime enforcement.

options.title: Pause the ownership cluster
options.body: Defer both competing implementations until legacy authority and recovery policy are defined.

recommendation.title: Adopt fail-closed enforcement
recommendation.body: Use this branch, require exact owner equality immediately, document supported recovery for legacy rows, and obtain deployed proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Josh is the strongest history-based owner for the projection and persisted-session boundary that distinguishes this implementation.
